name: German Workshop Order (Werkstattauftrag)
description: German workshop and repair orders (Werkstattauftrag, Reparaturauftrag, Auftragsbestätigung) from dealer and independent-garage systems. Hides the customer: name or company (after Herrn/Frau/Firma, in the address window, after Kunde:/Auftraggeber:/Halter:/Ansprechpartner:/z. Hd.), street and PLZ Ort, phone and mobile numbers, e-mail, every German licence plate (M-AB 1234, LÖ-X 99E, HH XY 1234H, also in free text) and only the last 6 characters of the VIN/FIN, so the first 11 stay readable. The workshop's name, letterhead, sender line, footer, switchboard number (ending in -0), fax, e-mail at workshop domains and staff names (Serviceberater:, Annahme:, Monteur:) stay visible, as do order and customer numbers, dates, km-Stand, Erstzulassung, HSN/TSN, make and model, work positions, part numbers, AW, prices and VAT. Limits: on scans and photos a name or address with no label or salutation on the same line (the address window) is not found and must be covered by hand; a workshop number without -0 (or a direct line without a Durchwahl label) is covered like a customer number; a VIN wrapped onto two lines is not recognised.

patterns.name: FIN-Ende
patterns.description: Last 6 characters of the VIN/FIN (serial part); the first 11 stay readable. Continuous, with a space before the serial, or printed in groups.

patterns.name: Kennzeichen
patterns.description: German licence plates: M-AB 1234, LÖ-X 99E, B AB 123, HH XY 1234H, also inside free text.

patterns.name: Kundenname
patterns.description: Customer or company name: after Herrn/Frau, in the address window, after Kunde:/Auftraggeber:/Halter:/Ansprechpartner:/z. Hd. Staff after Serviceberater:/Annahme:/Monteur: and 'Herr Vorname Nachname' stay readable.

patterns.name: Kundenadresse
patterns.description: Customer street and PLZ Ort: in the address window, after Anschrift:/Straße:/PLZ Ort:, or a line made only of 'Straße Nr, PLZ Ort'. The workshop letterhead, sender line and footer stay readable.

patterns.name: Telefon Kunde
patterns.description: Landline and mobile numbers in German notation. Switchboard numbers ending in -0 and numbers after Fax/Durchwahl/Notdienst/Zentrale stay readable.

patterns.name: E-Mail Kunde
patterns.description: E-mail addresses, except those at workshop-like domains (autohaus-, kfz-, werkstatt-, autoservice-, reifen-, garage-...).
